summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing for WarungPintar (offline Expo POS). Verified all 3 new features (Diskon Transaksi, Kasbon/Hutang, Kelola Kategori) end-to-end plus Laporan regression. 100% of tested flows PASSED (22/22 assertions across two runs). PIN creation, discounted checkout (Rp & %), receipt rows, Kasbon full flow with DP + customer fields + partial/full payment + validation, Kategori CRUD + duplicate rejection + product reassignment on delete, and Laporan showing correct Pendapatan Kotor (Rp 87.000 = 17.000 discounted + 70.000 kasbon), KASBON badge and 'Diskon Rp 2.000' note — all working. No backend involved (100% AsyncStorage). No deprecated Expo packages found. No React Native red screens. Only console noise: 'shadow*' style props and 'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings from React Native Web (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — appears in FAB / cards on RN Web. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/stok.tsx lines 235-238 (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset) and any other component using shadow* props.

Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' — coming from a dependency (likely react-native-keyboard-controller or expo BlurView). Non-blocking; check dependency versions.

action_items: (Optional/nice-to-have) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings (see stok.tsx FAB, and any card using shadow*).
(Optional) After RN 0.79+ ensure any child props.pointerEvents is moved into style.pointerEvents in your own components (currently seems to originate from a lib).
No functional fixes required — all 3 new features work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: StoreContext.tsx at 528 lines is close to but under the 700-line split threshold; if more features are added, split into auth/products/cart/checkout/debts/categories modules.
checkout.tsx handleSave correctly disables Save both by 'disabled' prop and re-validates on press — good defense in depth.
hutang.tsx correctly validates payAmount<=payingRemaining before calling payDebt; store's payDebt also clamps via status recompute.
categories.tsx renameCategory + deleteCategory in StoreContext also cascade to products (moves to 'Lainnya' fallback) — verified in test (Rokok deletion did not orphan products).
Transaction normalization on load handles legacy (pre-discount) tx by defaulting discount=0/status=lunas — safe migration.
seed_data_creation: App seeds 8 products automatically on first launch (Minyak Goreng, Beras, Gula, Aqua, Teh Botol, Chitato, Indomie, Rinso). No manual seeding required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (Diskon, Kasbon, Kategori) verified 100% functional. Fresh browser session starts at 'Buat PIN Baru' screen — enter 123456 twice via [data-testid=pin-key-<digit>] buttons. Tab bar has testIDs tab-kasir, tab-stok, tab-kasbon, tab-laporan, tab-atur but due to Expo Router keeping mounted layouts, multiple elements can match the same testID — use a helper that picks the LAST visible match (see script). Same applies to product-card-*, checkout-quick-*, debt-pay-*. Discount uses parseRupiah (digits only). Laporan Pendapatan Kotor sums tx.total (after discount). Print/Share buttons cannot be tested on web preview.
